meta.name: add-ollama-tool
meta.description: Add Ollama MCP server so the container agent can call local models and optionally manage the Ollama model library.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 添加本地 Ollama 服务，容器代理可直接调用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你的容器代理需要调用本地 Ollama 模型，又不想手动折腾配置
copy.tagline_en: Connect your container agent to local Ollama models
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your container agent needs to call local Ollama models and you'd prefer a straightforward setup

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 能调用本机 Ollama 模型:列出已装模型、让选定的模型生成文本。若开启模型管理开关,还能拉取或删除模型。安装时会在项目里复制并注册所需文件。
howto.when: 当你说“把 Ollama 工具加进来”“让代理调用本机模型”这类要求时触发。Claude 会先检查该项目是否已接入:已接入就跳到配置;若没有,会检查 Ollama 守护进程是否可访问。

say.text: 用 Ollama 告诉我法国的首都是哪里。
say.note: Claude 会先列出可用模型,再用其中一个生成回答。
需要已开启模型管理开关才会执行。

say.text: 当前有哪些 Ollama 模型已加载到内存中?
say.note: 将查看当前内存中已加载的模型。

howto.what_en: After setup Claude can use local Ollama models: list installed models, have a selected model generate text, and, if enabled, pull or delete models. Setup also copies and registers the needed files.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to add Ollama integration or let the agent call local models. If already wired, it skips to configuration; otherwise it checks whether the Ollama daemon is reachable.

say_en.text: Use Ollama to tell me the capital of France.
say_en.note: Lists models first, then generates an answer.
Works only when management tools are enabled.

say_en.text: Which Ollama models are loaded in memory right now?
say_en.note: Returns the models currently loaded in memory.
